about: The owner's own messages, word for word, from the Asked lines of docs/architecture/ideas.md (id105 to id116; id105 holds two). The model answers as the owner's assistant, in the language of the message, no tools. Scored with a judge (or35, task 1): an outside AI reads the message and the replies of the three arms and says which reply is better and why; a reply is good when it wins or ties its round. The arms: sonnet-low (today's talk), sonnet-medium, and split (a strong model writes a short brief, a cheap model writes the reply from it).
